The files in MagmPaper/Assets/CursorPreviews are previews derived from
Bibata Modern Ice, Bibata Modern Classic, Bibata Modern Amber, and GoogleDot Black
by ful1e5 and their contributors. The cursor artwork and these derived previews
are distributed under GNU GPL version 3. See CURSOR-PREVIEWS-GPL-3.0.txt.

The original artwork, sources, and release archives are available at:
https://github.com/ful1e5/Bibata_Cursor/releases/tag/v2.0.7
https://github.com/ful1e5/Google_Cursor/releases/tag/v2.0.0

The preview images use the Regular variant. Each vertical 64-pixel cell is a
static rendering of a CUR, or the first frame of an ANI, in CursorFiles.Roles
order. A blank cell represents a state absent from that pack. The cursors are
centered within their cells and limited to a size of 64×64 pixels.
